gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed newly diagnosed glioblastoma (WHO grade IV)

candidate_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] Experimental: Personalized dendritic cell vaccine ZSNneo-DC1.1 in combination with temozolomide. (interventions: Biological: Personalized Dendritic Cell Vaccine ZSNeo-DC1.1; Drug: Temozolomide (TMZ))
[ACTIVE_COMPARATOR] Control: Standard adjuvant temozolomide chemotherapy alone (interventions: Drug: Temozolomide (TMZ))

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed newly diagnosed glioblastoma (WHO grade IV)
Completion of tumor debulking surgery followed by standard concurrent chemoradiotherapy

role_evidence.quote: Patients receive six subcutaneous injections of ZSNeo-DC1.1 during adjuvant temozolomide chemotherapy.

agents.drug_class_hint: personalized neoantigen-pulsed autologous dendritic cell vaccine (ZSNeo-DC1.1)

role_evidence.quote: [ACTIVE_COMPARATOR] Control: Standard adjuvant temozolomide chemotherapy alone (interventions: Drug: Temozolomide (TMZ))

biomarkers.biomarker_other: tumour neoantigens (confirmed for personalized vaccine manufacture)

source_quote.quote: After confirmation of tumor neoantigens and eligibility, patients will be randomized in a 1:1 ratio to receive either ZSNeo-DC1.1 in combination with TMZ or TMZ alone.

coder_notes: Only investigational agent is a dendritic cell vaccine (excluded intervention type); temozolomide is the standard adjuvant backbone given in both arms. Tumour neoantigen confirmation is a pre-randomisation requirement for vaccine manufacture; listed as other/eligibility, not candidate-matched because there is no pharmacological candidate. Exploratory antigen-specific T-cell responses relate to the vaccine, not a candidate. The vaccine intervention lists 'other names: Temozolomide', apparently a registry entry error.
